videos.headline: J Richardson to Anderson, out Caught by Green!! That's it! AUS 2-0 ENG! Jhye Richardson gets his first five-for in Test cricket! And what an opportune moment this is to pick up your first five-for! Anderson is pushed back by a short of length ball, has a little poke at it, and that flies off a healthy outside edge to Green's left, and he's been terrific at gully this Test, as he dives to the left to secure a second successive Test win this series. That's Adelaide conquered by Australia, for the second year in a row. Anderson c Green b J Richardson 2(5)

J Richardson to Buttler, out Hit Wkt!! We thought we'd seen everything, with Ollie Robinson bowling, but this really puts a seal on England's predicament. That's banged in on a back of a length, Buttler has tapped it on the head off the backfoot, but he's standing too deep in his crease, and manages to trod on his stumps. Of all the ways to get out, that's gotta hurt. Particularly when you're trying to save a Test. He's nearly played 35 overs, taps it on the head to point, nearly goes for the run, but then looks back and sees the mess he's made. Unbelievable. Buttler hit wkt b J Richardson 26(207) [4s-2]

Lyon to Robinson, out Caught by Smith!! Edged and swallowed at first slip! Just the tonic Australia needed before the break. Lyon was always a threat, it was only a matter of him landing it in the right areas with the right angles. This is round-the-wicket, and goes with the angle while Robinson searches for any turn on offer. Ends up getting the outside edge and the Australian skipper holds on in the cordon. Now then, just two more wickets remaining for Australia. One more right now and the break will have to be extended. Robinson c Smith b Lyon 8(39) [4s-1]

J Richardson to Woakes, out Bowled!! Through the gate. The breakthrough that Australia so badly wanted. Woakes's stubborn stay ends with a nip backer hitting top of middle and leg. It was a length delivery around off stump, Woakes looks to defend, but the ball jags back in to surprise the England all-rounder and he had left a big enough gap between bat and pad for the ball to sneak through. Richardson breaks the 61-run stand and his teammates mob him. Australia now three wickets away with more belief. Woakes b J Richardson 44(97) [4s-7]

Lyon to Stokes, out Lbw!! Excellent review and Australia have the big fish! This didn't seem that close in real time, but Smith opted for the review, probably as it was Stokes at the crease. Was the slider that pitched on leg stump and as Stokes was right back in the crease, he was always going to be in trouble if he missed one. He did this time although it appeared to be maybe sliding down leg. However, replays show that Lyon got it to straighten just a tad, enough for ball tracking to show Three Reds. Massive breakthrough this and the countdown might just have started you'd think. Stokes was happy playing Lyon off the back foot most of the time, and it was working too, until this. Stokes lbw b Lyon 12(77) [4s-1]

Starc to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Smith!! The change of angle works instantly for Starc! He had started round-the-wicket to Pope and got him settled to that angle, and now with the first one from the over-the-stumps, has the right-hander sucked into a fatal poke. Pope was unsure whether to play or leave, and just hung his bat at it eventually. Thick edge and Smith at second slip does the rest. There is that early strike that Australia were seeking. This will surely fire up Starc. Ollie Pope c Smith b Starc 4(7) [4s-1]

Starc to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Smith!! The change of angle works instantly for Starc! He had started round-the-wicket to Pope and got him settled to that angle, and now with the first one from the over-the-stumps, has the right-hander sucked into a fatal poke. Pope was unsure whether to play or leave, and just hung his bat at it eventually. Thick edge and Smith at second slip does the rest. There is that early strike that Australia were seeking. This will surely fire up Starc. Ollie Pope c Smith b Starc 4(7) [4s-1]

Starc to Root, out Caught by Carey!! Edgedddd and gone! This is a heartbreak for Root and England. The captain took a serious blow, wasn't moving well and is fighting it out there despite pain, but having surived all that, he nicks off final over of the day. Oh this game is cruel sometimes. Starc bowls a fullish delivery that angles in and then leaves Root late. Root wasn't fully forward, tried to defend, got a thick edge and Carey stayed low to take a good grab to the right. Root c Carey b Starc 24(67) [4s-1]

J Richardson to Rory Burns, out Caught by Smith!! Edgeddd and a good low diving grab to the right at second slip. Richardson has worked Burns out here. Got an edge that missed gully, took one past the edge with extra bounce, now finds the edge that carries to the fielder. That front leg across the line and then hard hands at this fullish delivery that leaves the left-hander, thick edge. Unfortunately for Burns it doesn't hit the ground. This was a pressure innings for him. Got a start, but fails to convert. The ploy to get Richardon in from round the wicket works for Australia. Rory Burns c Smith b J Richardson 34(95) [4s-5]

Neser to Malan, out Lbw!! Neser breaks the partnership! Beautifully bowled this, angling in just around off stump and straightening ever so slightly to sneak past Malan's pushy defence. Struck on the front pad and it seemed dead in real time. The ump liked it too and it was surprising to see Malan opt for the review. There wasn't any way for him to escape unless he had gotten an inside edge. Which he hadn't. Three Reds on ball tracking. Timely strike for the Aussies. Malan lbw b Neser 20(52) [4s-4]

J Richardson to Haseeb Hameed, out Caught by Carey!! What a set-up this was! The uncertainty of seam has done it again! Right into the corridor of uncertainty, with that tempting inward angle, gets it to seam away and gets it to bounce a little extra too, takes the glove as he lunges low to defend, and that flies to Carey the keeper for a regulation catch! Once again, an early blow for England. Haseeb Hameed c Carey b J Richardson 0(6)

Malan to Labuschagne, out Caught by Stokes!! Goes for the slog sweep again, hasn't connected properly and holes out to deep mid-wicket. Labuschagne wanted to clear the ropes in pursuit of quick runs. Got it off the bottom part of the blade. Another neat innings from Labuschagne. Labuschagne c Stokes b Malan 51(96) [4s-6]

Robinson to Head, out Caught by Stokes!! That's a stunner from Stokes in the deep! The all-rounder showing his mates how to take catches. Was an effort ball from Robinson, dug it in short and Head was always going to take it on. Gets rushed on the pull stroke and the top-edge is taken with a superb dive at deep mid-wicket. Was dipping on Stokes but he judged it well and timed the dive perfectly. Fine knock from Head though, was an enterprising knock under pressure. Head c Stokes b Robinson 51(54) [4s-7]

Robinson to Smith, out Caught by Buttler!! And Buttler turns it around again! It's not the best ball from Robinson, a short of length one down the leg-side, Smith would put that away 999 times out of 1000, but this time he hops and just gets a bit of glove on the attempted tuck towards fine leg, deflects towards the left of Buttler who dives to his left to hold onto it. He's taken two screamers to his left, and dropped a tough one and a sitter to his right. He's also taken a terrific one to his right though - that of Harris in the first innings. That was down leg-side too. Maybe he's better with leg-side catches. Smith c Buttler b Robinson 6(31) [4s-1]

Broad to Marcus Harris, out Caught by Buttler!! A bit of DK in Buttler - drops sitters, takes screamers! This one has seamed sharply away from round the wicket, drawing Harris into the poke, and even though it's a checked drive towards the covers, a thick edge has flown to the left of Buttler who throws himself to his left to take a spellbinding catch! All will be forgotten about that sitter that he dropped. Do I sniff an English comeback? Marcus Harris c Buttler b Broad 23(66) [4s-3]

Anderson to Neser, out Bowled! Thats' an absolute beauty! Lands it on a good length and gets the wobbly seam to jag back in through the gate in the defence, and it crashes into the stumps! Neser, the nightwatchman last night, has to head back to the pavilion. Neser b Anderson 3(13)

Root to Marcus Harris, out Warner Run Out!! England have a wicket out of nowhere! Warner furiously storms off the field in anger. Not sure what these two were thinking. This was worked towards square leg and a single was never on there, definitely not after the initial hesitation. They still go through and it's almost both batters at the same end, as Harris had crossed and Warner didn't really go back. So, the latter had to be the one to go. Lucky break for England. They just weren't bowling threatening enough. Warner run out (Broad/Buttler) 13(38) [4s-1]

Green to Stokes, out Bowled!! Knocked him over! Huge moment! Stokes clears his front leg and tries to flay this through the off-side, gets a thick under-edge that crashes into the stumps. Stokes looks absolutely gutted, but perhaps he gets some time to nurse his injuries - given the volatility of the England top order, and England's overall predicament in the context of this match, he may even need to bat again today. Stokes b Green 34(98) [4s-3 6s-1]

Lyon to Robinson, out Lbw!! This one's been given LBW, and Robinson review. Struck outside off? Yeah, looks like it. Gets back and across, tries working it across the line, a little too fine perhaps. No bat on it - nothing on hotspot, but forward short leg is blocking it. Nothing on Snicko. Umpire's call for impact, and that's crashes into the top of middle! They retain the review, but Robinson has to head back. Robinson lbw b Lyon 0(7)

Lyon to Robinson, out Lbw!! This one's been given LBW, and Robinson review. Struck outside off? Yeah, looks like it. Gets back and across, tries working it across the line, a little too fine perhaps. No bat on it - nothing on hotspot, but forward short leg is blocking it. Nothing on Snicko. Umpire's call for impact, and that's crashes into the top of middle! They retain the review, but Robinson has to head back. Robinson lbw b Lyon 0(7)

Lyon to Woakes, out Bowled!! He's played on! Weight forward because of the flight, hastily gets onto the backfoot but forgets to bring his bat back with him, ends up with an ugly prod outside off, as it spins back in, takes the inside edge, and breaches the gap between bat and pad to crash into the stumps! Woakes b Lyon 24(40) [4s-5]

Starc to Buttler, out Caught by Warner!! Edgeddd and straight to first slip. Starc need not have to change the angle. Starc was just trying one thing - to angle it across with away movement and look for the edge. Kept probing away in that zone and beat Buttler on the drive and defence quite a few times. Yet nothing stops Buttler from playing that shot. Oh Jos Buttler. It's a fine line between being positive and ignoring the trap. You decide! Probably he backed himself to get it right, but should he have had to curb with the team slumping after a century stand. Went for the drive and nicked off. Low grab for Davey. Six down. Starc has three. Buttler c Warner b Starc 0(15)

Lyon to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Labuschagne!! Lyon has his man this time! Pope was all at sea against the seasoned off-spinner and the youngster has been put out of his misery. Comes charging down, trying to work with the spin on this off break but there is a hint of extra bounce and all he can manage is a big inside edge. Labuschagne reacts sharply at short leg to pouch this. England sink further. It's officially a mini-collapse now. Ollie Pope c Labuschagne b Lyon 5(19) [4s-1]

Starc to Malan, out Caught by Smith!! The bowling change works like magic! Logically, Green could have continued but Smith opted for Starc and the left-armer has struck big off the fifth ball of his new spell. Not a wicket-taking ball though, shortish and outside off, Malan is rushed by the extra lift off the deck as he goes for a slash-cut. Only gets a thick edge that flies through to first slip. Smith takes a sharp grab. England are now in a spot of bother with both set batters dislodged. Australia can smell blood here. Malan c Smith b Starc 80(157) [4s-10]

Green to Root, out Caught by Smith!! Green breaks the partnership! The last few deliveries gave the feeling that this was on the cards. He was getting a bit of lift and movement from a length, and Root wasn't looking comfortable. This is another similar delivery, he goes poking at it and gets a healthy edge to first slip. Australia needed a wicket early in the session to rev themselves up and not only have they got one, but it's also a massive one. Root c Smith b Green 62(116) [4s-7]

Neser to Haseeb Hameed, out Caught by Starc!! Neser gets a wicket off his second ball in Test cricket! What a moment this is! There was a campaign to give Neser a Baggy Green, and he's done everything right until now to justidy it! Picks a full one off the pads and flicks with no control, ends up swatting it straight to Starc at mid-on! Incredible scenes here! His teammates are ecstatic! Haseeb Hameed c Starc b Neser 6(21)

Starc to Rory Burns, out Caught by Smith!! Edgeddd, bounce, taken at second slip. Burns's misery continues. Back of a length delivery nipping away around off stump, Burns pokes at the ball, completely squared up in defence and the thick edge carries at a comfortable height for the standin Aussie skipper to pouch it. Is it that front leg trigger far too across the line and the head position falling away? You decide! Rory Burns c Smith b Starc 4(3) [4s-1]

Stokes to Neser, out Caught by Broad!! in the airr, in the airr, no timing. Broad settles under it and takes the catch at mid-on. Starc isn't running off, so Australia will carry on with the bat. Full delivery in the slot, Neser thought he could muscle that down the ground, the bat turned in his hands and the mistimed hit flew. Broad moved back from mid-on and took it over his right shoulder. Not easy those. Neser gets a great ovation as he walks off. Neser c Broad b Stokes 35(24) [4s-5 6s-1]

Anderson to Carey, out Caught by Haseeb Hameed!! Spoons it straight to short cover! Probably the off-cutter from Anderson, and Carey hasn't picked it at all. Gets a touch early into the stroke and hence gets the timing of the drive all wrong. Hameed takes a sharp low catch. Break time! Carey c Haseeb Hameed b Anderson 51(107) [4s-5]

Anderson to Smith, out Lbw!! Heartbreak for Smith! He was looking all set for another Test hundred but that'll have to wait now. Anderson strikes in his first over of a new spell. This was pitched up and stayed a fraction, seamed in slightly as Smith shuffled across for the flick. Struck on the pads and it did look close in real time. Smith reviewed straightaway though, hoping that the impact would save him. That was the only thing that could have, but as it turns out, it's ump's call and that means, the on-field call will stay on impact. It's hitting the stumps and that's the end of a fine knock from Smith. Smith lbw b Anderson 93(201) [4s-12 6s-1]

Stokes to Green, out Bowled!! So he's not just all about the short ball ploy he says. Simple ball. Fullish delivery that pinned the batter to the front foot and then moved away just enough to beat the defence to hit top of off stump. How simple is it to bowl that ball? Two quick wickets for England then. Green will feel I didn't do much wrong there, but it's the angle of Ben Stokes that did the trick. Green b Stokes 2(5)

Root to Head, out Bowled!! Oh he is knocked him over. So it wasn't just for the over rate you see. He roars. Head played a rash flick shot, was deceived in the flight by this full flighted delivery that dipped on him, Head was on the move on the flick and lost balance. Missed the ball and it turned enough to hit leg stump. The balance was all over the place from Head. Credit to Root for foxing the batter. Langer and Co. will not be happy with that shot. Head b Root 18(36) [4s-3]

Robinson to Labuschagne, out Lbw!! Labuschagne has finally been dislodged! Robinson has his man eventually and no, he hasn't overstepped this time. Nor is the DRS going to save the batter. Nicely bowled nip-backer this, a touch fuller than Labuschagne expected and he offered no shot. He'd been doing this a lot, trusting the bounce totally. On this occasion, it's the length that he has misread and it's cost him. Struck on the pads and it looked dead in real time. Labuschagne, probably due to his run of luck, sent it upstairs, only to see Three Reds on ball tracking. A fine knock nevertheless, he's done his job even though obviously he'd have wanted more runs. Labuschagne lbw b Robinson 103(305) [4s-8]

Stokes to Warner, out Caught by Broad!! NO way! What have you done Mike Hussey! Warnie must be fuming! Warne, Warner, Warnest! He's picked a short and wide one, flat-batted this straight to Broad at cover, who is quick enough to hold onto this in his 150th Test. Warner did cop a blow and is playing with an injury, but he's played extremely well today. Soz Huss, this one's on you! Warner c Broad b Stokes 95(167) [4s-11]

Broad to Marcus Harris, out Caught by Buttler!! Edgeddd and taken. Stunning grab diving to the right from Jos B. He was fully horizontal to the ground when he caught that. With a leg gully in, Broad bowled the short delivery down leg, Harris played the pull but had no control over the shot because he was well inside the line. The ball seems to have gone off the back of the bat, but Buttler was so alert to react quickly to the right and take a brilliant catch to get Australia's opener. Marcus Harris c Buttler b Broad 3(28)
